VghLantern__DocManagement__Config__Descr: System configuration overlay for the Document Management Mode project table. Merged over VghLantern__AppConfig__Main__.json by the ConfigLoader, so read every value through StateManager.VghLantern__StateManager__GetAppConfig() rather than fetching this file directly.
